name: Qualify Influencer Partnership
summary: Qualify creator partnerships using audience evidence, brand safety, rights, disclosure, and economics.
description: Qualify and structure an influencer or creator partnership using audience fit, content quality, authenticity, brand safety, disclosure, usage rights, measurement, and commercial terms. Use before outreach, contracting, gifting, or renewing a creator campaign.
refuses: It does not buy undisclosed endorsements, fake engagement, reviews, or deceptive testimonials.
It does not scrape private audience data or target protected or sensitive traits.
It does not contact, contract, pay, publish, or grant usage rights without explicit authority.
